'''Coruscant Medical''' was a medical center on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. After being severely wounded on the planet [[Haruun Kal/Legends|Haruun Kal]], the [[Korun/Legends|Korun]], [[Nick Rostu]], was treated at Coruscant Medical where his life was saved by the finest medical treatment available, a luxury assured by the [[Jedi Council/Legends|Jedi Council]]. While he recovered in the center, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]], visited him a number of times.
